let table = "meta"
let columns = ["id"; "owner"]
let key ~doc = Bind.uuid (Json.uuid doc "id")
let row ~self ~parent ~pos ~doc =
  let _ = parent in
  let _ = pos in
  let r = Meta.make ~id:Neutral.uuid ~owner:(Json.string doc "owner") in
  let r = Meta.set_id r (Unbind.uuid self) in
  [Bind.uuid (Meta.id r); Bind.string (Meta.owner r)]

let table = "runs"
